title: Morning Brief — Tuesday, 27 October 2026
description: A new federal election funding system with lower disclosure thresholds and donation caps is set for 2027, Stanwell Power Station workers are reassured their jobs are secure under Queensland's energy transition, and the Gold Coast braces for fresh severe thunderstorm warnings. 한국어 방송도 이어집니다.
